back_translation: The words of Amos, who was one of the shepherds of Tekoa, which he received as a vision concerning Israel in the reign of Uzziah king of Judah and in the reign of Jeroboam son of Joash king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.
He said: The LORD roars from Zion and utters His voice from Jerusalem; the pastures of the shepherds mourn, and the top of Carmel withers.
Thus says the LORD: For three transgressions of Damascus, or for four, I will not hold back the punishment, because they threshed Gilead with iron threshing-sledges.
I will send fire upon the house of Hazael, and it will consume the citadels of Ben-hadad.
I will break the bar of the gate of Damascus, and cut off the inhabitant of the Valley of Aven and the scepter-holder from Beth-eden; and the people of Aram will go into exile to Kir, says the LORD.
Thus says the LORD: For three transgressions of Gaza, or for four, I will not hold back the punishment, because they carried a whole community into exile to deliver them up to Edom.
I will send fire upon the wall of Gaza, and it will consume its citadels.
I will cut off the inhabitant of Ashdod and the scepter-holder from Ashkelon; I will turn My hand against Ekron, and the remnant of the Philistines will perish, says the Lord GOD.

Thus says the LORD: For three transgressions of Tyre, or for four, I will not hold back the punishment, because they handed over a whole community as captives to Edom and did not remember the covenant of brotherhood.
I will send fire upon the wall of Tyre, and it will consume its citadels.

Thus says the LORD: For three transgressions of Edom, or for four, I will not hold back the punishment, because he pursued his brother with the sword and cast away all compassion; his anger raged continually, and he kept his fury forever.
I will send fire upon Teman, and it will consume the citadels of Bozrah.

Thus says the LORD: For three transgressions of the Ammonites, or for four, I will not hold back the punishment, because they ripped open the pregnant women of Gilead in order to enlarge their territory.
I will kindle a fire on the wall of Rabbah, and it will consume its citadels, amid shouting on the day of battle, amid a tempest on the day of the whirlwind.
Their king will go into exile, he and his princes together, says the LORD.
